title: Gemini 3 Flash quietly upgraded in LM Arena
summary: Google updated the Gemini 3 Flash slug in LM Arena (rebranded as Arena) with a checkpoint whose output quality is reported to approach Gemini 3.1 Pro. Google also notified Vertex AI customers that Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite will become generally available.

research.notes: Anonymous arena checkpoint; slug unchanged so version identification is unverified.
